title: Emails sent straight to the mailboxes are saved in CMS Messages
changes: Emails that people send directly to contact@, support@, suggestions@, comments@ or alerts@ are saved in CMS > Messages as well (sender, subject, text; no attachments), next to the form messages; Gmail still gets them
steps: Upload the zip to /home2/runoncon/ and unzip it, then: chmod 755 public_html/api/v1/cron/mail-in.php
cPanel > Forwarders > Add Forwarder for each mailbox > Advanced Options > Pipe to a Program: public_html/api/v1/cron/mail-in.php
